Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Virginia Gregg is credited on 761 distinct recordings across 37 programs from 1942-11-17 through 1979-07-26. Documented roles include performer on 759 recordings, commercial spokesman on 1 recordings, and commercial spokeswoman on 1 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar (performer on 277 recordings; 277 distinct recordings), Have Gun, Will Travel (performer on 75 recordings; 75 distinct recordings), Richard Diamond, Private Detective (performer on 74 recordings; 74 distinct recordings), Let George Do It (performer on 50 recordings; 50 distinct recordings), Dr. Kildare (performer on 39 recordings; 39 distinct recordings), The Line Up (performer on 38 recordings; 38 distinct recordings), Gunsmoke (performer on 31 recordings; 31 distinct recordings), and Dragnet (performer on 23 recordings; 23 distinct recordings).

Documented character portrayals include Helen Asher (74 portrayals), Claire Brooks (58 portrayals), Miss Wong (2 portrayals), and Nurse Parker (1 portrayals).
